operator.title: Operator
operator.body: OpenFloorball is self-hosted software. The operator of this instance is the administrator who set up this server — not the developers of the software. All data remains exclusively on this server; no data is transferred to third parties.

dataCategories.title: What data is stored?
dataCategories.account: Account: email address, display name, password (encrypted hash), role
dataCategories.boards: Boards: names, notes, frames (positions/formations), attacking/defensive lines

purpose.title: Purpose & retention period
purpose.body: This data is used solely to provide the app's functionality (tactics board, board management). It is stored for as long as your account exists and is fully deleted from the active database as soon as you delete your account (Settings → Account → Delete account). If the operator has enabled automatic backups, your data may still be contained in already-created backup archives until the configured retention period (max. 90 days) expires.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: At any time, in Settings (the "Data" section), you can:
rights.accessBody: (Art. 15 GDPR) – view all stored data directly
rights.exportBody: (Art. 20 GDPR) – download all data as a ZIP file
rights.rectifyBody: (Art. 16 GDPR) – change your name, email, and password at any time
rights.deleteBody: (Art. 17 GDPR) – permanently remove your account and all associated data

shareLinkNotice.title: Share links
shareLinkNotice.body: If you create a share link for a board, the board name along with all frames/positions and formations can be viewed through it without logging in — no account data is included. Share links automatically expire after a limited time and become invalid afterward.

noThirdParty.title: No third parties, no tracking
noThirdParty.body: OpenFloorball does not integrate any external analytics or tracking services. No data is shared with third parties. The only cookie used is a technically necessary, httpOnly-secured session cookie for login.

security.title: Security
security.body: The database is only reachable within the internal Docker network, not from outside. For accessing this app over the internet, we recommend running it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS. Access logs do not contain full IP addresses (anonymized).

export.title: 📤 Export
export.shareFileNotSupported: Sharing this file isn't supported by this browser.
export.shareHint: Accessible without login — only share with people you trust. The board name and all frames/positions and formations are visible, but no account data. The link expires automatically.
export.qrAlt: QR code for the share link
export.frameShareHint: Shares only the currently displayed frame as an image, accessible without login — e.g. for WhatsApp. Expires automatically.

rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: This page summarizes the key IFF game rules and field specifications that OpenFloorball is based on.
rules.sourceLink: Official source: IFF Rules of the Game

ball.title: Ball Specifications
ball.body: The ball must be a single non-fluorescent color. Official competition colors are white, red, or orange. Weight: 23 ± 1 grams, diameter approx. 72mm.

teamColors.title: Team Colors
teamColors.body: Home and away teams must wear distinguishable colors. Configurable in OpenFloorball's settings.

positions.title: Positions (2-1-2 System)
positions.intro: The standard full-field system consists of one goalkeeper, two defenders, one centre, and two attackers.
positions.goalkeeperDesc: Defends the goal; the only position with special rules (kneeling, hand play allowed inside the crease).
positions.defenderDesc: Secures the defensive half, prevents shots on goal.
positions.centreDesc: Link between defense and attack, covers the most ground.
positions.attackerDesc: Seeks goal-scoring opportunities, presses the opposing defense.

rules.sourceNote: Sources: IFF Rules of the Game, IFF 3v3 Rules, IFF Material Regulations.
